comment: Mutation targets: (target file, test command) pairs. 'before' runs only the module tests that existed before the tiered tests (their kernel/Makefile recipes, rebuilt by tests/harness/tiers.py); 'after' adds the tiered tests. Commands run from the repository root. 'lines' limits a large file to the part in scope. 'ci' is the small fixed subset the CI job gates on; its baselines are the measured 'after' scores (tests/MUTATION_REPORT.md).

ci.baseline_note: measured 'after' scores on p10-integrate (tests/MUTATION_REPORT.md), rounded down to 4 places: rmag_core 86/90 (after the F-RMAG-OVF fix and its tests), fs_malloc 30/36, settle 175/197 (the 22 survivors are equivalent: array sizes, ties in the payer/payee pick, a loose loop bound, a dead NULL branch); zxv_engine 334/377 measured locally but 323/377 on the ubuntu-22.04 runner (twice, same count): the extra local kills are mutants that read uninitialized stack (a 31-byte seed copy, an out-of-range bucket index) or defensive re-checks of the abacus output, whose outcome depends on the machine, so the baseline is the runner's measurement; lpres_hex 184/211 (the 27 survivors are equivalent: array sizes, masks of already-masked values, ties between equal ranks, a hash buffer larger than needed, seq shifts that only differ past 127 records); mk_pay 119/130 (the 11 survivors are equivalent: array sizes, the static assert, seq bytes above 2^56, a loop bound reading a zeroed line, the always-zero escrow line of an invoice); vhub 281/296 (the 15 survivors are equivalent: array and buffer sizes, a tag copy whose extra byte is overwritten, a seed copy whose extra byte is overwritten by the tag, severity values that only set an order, running the default no-rule tag twice, an unreachable vbills == 0 and an unreachable zero quote step, the sign of a negative not-found index). Workers now get their own ZXV_TMP, so make-driven targets no longer race on /tmp paths; swarm_denom 468/473 (the 5 survivors are equivalent: a saturation check whose two branches return the same UINT64_MAX, the canonical-compare loop skipping tier 0 (two equal-value wallets cannot differ only there), the Fibonacci index search starting at 1 instead of 2, a pos > cap check already covered by the room check, and a loop start that only writes a bit the closing 1 then overwrites); zxvd_rpc 552/743 measured locally with the swarm earnings bridge (74.3%; was 492/677; gate 0.74; runs in .github/workflows/zxvd.yml, own_job, not in ci.yml's subset). Its 191 survivors are equivalent or need a fault the test cannot cause: buffer and array sizes, the private unit's minor units (only whole-unit amounts are posted), the earnings accounts failing to open (libzxv only refuses them for a disabled currency, which earn_open already rules out), -1 vs -2 error returns the callers only test against 0, descriptor checks that differ only at fd 0, stderr wording, allocation/socket/accept/mkdir failures, the libzxv version and context-creation failure paths, CR stripping (JSON already treats CR as whitespace), parameter readers returning true after the error is already recorded (the reply is the same error), cap/ctx destroy (a leak, not a behaviour), partial sends that need a client stalled past the 2 s send timeout, and the macOS-only peer check)
